clue.text: The prophet with a small house by the Galilean lake

parts.note: HO is the standard abbreviation for house
the Sea of Galilee is the lake in Galilee

explanation.surface: A biblical prophet living in a cottage on the shore of Galilee.
explanation.definitionFit: Hosea is one of the minor prophets of the Old Testament, with a book named after him.

clue.text: Bad luck! That's a difficult piece of verse

parts.note: hard means difficult
lines are a short passage of poetry

explanation.surface: Someone commiserates over a tough poem they must learn.
explanation.definitionFit: An old British exclamation of sympathy, like 'tough luck', said to someone unfortunate.

clue.text: The flyer to fight and fight on

parts.note: to spar is to fight, as boxers do
a row is a quarrel or fight

explanation.surface: A pilot's orders to keep battling on and on.
explanation.definitionFit: A sparrow is a small bird, and any bird is a creature that flies.

clue.text: A common drug found by investigative policemen

parts.note: the CID is Britain's Criminal Investigation Department, its plain-clothes detectives

explanation.surface: Detectives make a drugs find in a raid.
explanation.walkthrough: The CID (Criminal Investigation Department) is the detective branch of a British police force.
explanation.definitionFit: Acid is the street slang name for LSD, a widely used hallucinogen.

clue.text: His bible readings charm the heart of regular attender

indicators.note: the charm sits at the centre of the attender, so one word goes into the middle of the other

parts.note: a goer is someone who regularly attends, as a churchgoer
a spell is a magic charm

explanation.surface: A churchgoer is won over by the readings from scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: a gospeller is the one whose task is the Gospel reading, so 'His bible readings' points to that person.
explanation.definitionFit: In church services a gospeller is the cleric who reads the Gospel aloud during communion.

clue.text: It marks the anniversary of Long John getting spliced

parts.note: Long John Silver is the pirate in Treasure Island
spliced is slang for married, so getting spliced is a wedding

explanation.surface: Long John marries, and the date is remembered every year.
explanation.definitionFit: A twenty-fifth marriage anniversary is traditionally named after the precious metal.

clue.text: Dash out of the hotel anteroom

indicators.note: the letters are taken out of the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Someone rushes from the reception room of a hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: Elan is flair or verve, the same sense as dash meaning stylish vigour.

clue.text: Love in young girls needs to be given lots of rope

indicators.note: the love goes inside the young girls

parts.note: lasses are young girls
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: Romantic girls must be allowed plenty of freedom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Given lots of rope' looks like the idiom for freedom; literally, lassoes are ropes with nooses.
explanation.definitionFit: Lassoes are long ropes with running nooses used by cowboys, so plural loops of cord.

clue.text: Was in charge of the church on the cattlestation

parts.note: to run something is to be in charge of it

explanation.surface: A man managed the chapel on a cattle farm.
explanation.definitionFit: A ranch is a large farm for rearing livestock, called a station in Australia.

clue.text: Studying at a Berkshire university

definitions.meaning: ... a subject means studying it at university
the University of ... is in the county town of Berkshire

explanation.walkthrough: Berkshire is a county west of London; Reading is its largest town.
explanation.definitionFit: Studying is reading in the British academic sense; the Berkshire town gives its name to its university.

clue.text: Allow Unionist commander to go on a search for sappers

parts.note: Ulysses S. Grant led the Union armies in the American Civil War
the Royal Engineers, the army's sappers, are abbreviated RE
a quest is a search

explanation.surface: A general lets his engineers go looking for something.
explanation.definitionFit: To agree to what someone asks is the same as allowing them it.

clue.text: A lion is disposed to make contact

indicators.note: disposed means set out or arranged, so these letters are placed in a new order

explanation.surface: A lion feels inclined to approach someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A liaison is a working link between people or groups, a channel of communication.

clue.text: Large terrorist organisation gains currency

parts.note: the IRA is the Irish Republican Army

explanation.surface: A big militant group gets its hands on money.
explanation.definitionFit: The lira was the money of Italy before the euro, and is still Turkey's.

clue.text: Possess the right to vacillate

parts.note: to have is to possess
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Someone is entitled to keep changing their mind.
explanation.definitionFit: To haver is to dither or hesitate, waver between choices.

clue.text: Firm demand for silence in the club

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
sh is the sound made to tell someone to be quiet

explanation.surface: A business insists on quiet in the members' club.
explanation.definitionFit: A cosh is a short heavy bludgeon, a weapon like a truncheon.

clue.text: Obliged to set a limit

definitions.meaning: to mark its edges, to restrict it

explanation.definitionFit: Obliged is the 'duty-bound' sense; setting a limit is the verb meaning to enclose with a boundary.

clue.text: Parking needs good fortune and fortitude

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking
luck is good fortune

explanation.surface: Finding a parking space takes both luck and courage.
explanation.definitionFit: Pluck is courage, the spirited bravery that fortitude names.

clue.text: See how walnuts are produced in Australia

indicators.note: the letters are made into something new, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An invitation to watch a walnut harvest Down Under.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a state in south-eastern Australia, with Sydney as its capital, so it lies within that country.

clue.text: Gent with a boater against sunburn in New York

parts.note: a gent is a man
a boater is a flat straw hat
a tan is the bronzing of skin from the sun

explanation.surface: A gentleman in a straw hat protects himself from the sun in the city.
explanation.definitionFit: The central island borough of New York City, home of Wall Street and Broadway.

clue.text: Choice of words by Nicaraguan rebels arouses opposition

parts.note: the Contras were rebels fighting Nicaragua's Sandinista government in the 1980s
diction is a speaker's choice of words

explanation.surface: Rebel phrasing in Nicaragua stirs up hostility.
explanation.definitionFit: A contradiction is a denial or opposing statement, a stance against what was said.

clue.text: Rex gets on in fashionable surroundings over a protracted period

indicators.note: the fashionable word forms the surroundings, enclosing the other pieces

parts.note: chic means stylish or fashionable
R is the abbreviation for Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A king grows old in smart settings for a long time.
explanation.definitionFit: Chronic describes an illness or state lasting for a long time.

clue.text: I am sent to one art gallery to make a copy

parts.note: I'm is the contraction of I am
the Roman numeral for one is I
the Tate is the London art gallery

explanation.surface: Someone is sent to a gallery to reproduce a painting.
explanation.definitionFit: To imitate is to copy or mimic something.

clue.text: Artist about to become in short supply

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A painter is set to become scarce.
explanation.definitionFit: Rare means scarce, seldom found.

clue.text: Headstrong offer by artillerymen

parts.note: the Royal Artillery is abbreviated RA
a bid is an offer, as at an auction

explanation.surface: Gunners make a reckless proposal.
explanation.definitionFit: Rabid describes someone fanatical and unreasoning, as wilful as headstrong.

clue.text: The sea-food once a shilling a pound

parts.note: S was the abbreviation for the shilling, an old British coin worth a twentieth of a pound
a quid is slang for a pound

explanation.surface: A seafood dish once cost a shilling per pound weight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'once' marks S as a pre-decimal abbreviation: the shilling was a British coin until 1971.
explanation.definitionFit: Squid is a cephalopod eaten as seafood, often fried as calamari.

clue.text: Singer eager to make a comeback

indicators.note: a comeback returns the word the way it came, so it is read backwards

parts.note: avid means eager

explanation.surface: A performer keen to return to the stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to make a comeback' turns AVID round to DIVA.
explanation.definitionFit: A diva is a celebrated female opera singer.

clue.text: Mother, I am seriously hurt

parts.note: ma is a familiar word for mother
I'm is the contraction of I am

explanation.surface: A child cries to their mum that they are badly injured.
explanation.definitionFit: To maim is to wound or disable someone badly.

clue.text: Drinks in a provincial estaminet

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Beers being served in a country café.
explanation.walkthrough: An estaminet is a small French café or bar.
explanation.definitionFit: Ales are beers, alcoholic drinks.

clue.text: The heyday of Fleming's hero which kept people in thrall

parts.note: James Bond is the spy hero of Ian Fleming's novels
an age is an era, a period of glory

explanation.surface: The golden era of 007 films captivated audiences.
explanation.definitionFit: Bondage is slavery, the state of being held in servitude.

clue.text: Bitterness felt by the worker for a fine gentleman

parts.note: gall means bitterness or rancour
a worker ant is the standard crossword worker

explanation.surface: A labourer feels resentment towards a smart toff.
explanation.definitionFit: A gallant is a dashing, courteous man of fashion.

clue.text: Medicated shampoo down by ten per cent

indicators.note: a shampoo churns and lathers, so the letters are thoroughly mixed

explanation.surface: A medicated shampoo is on sale at a tenth off.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally, a decimated legion lost one man in every ten, so reduced by a tenth.

clue.text: The way to acquire a German tankard

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
ein is German for a

explanation.surface: Instructions for getting hold of a German beer mug.
explanation.definitionFit: A stein is a large earthenware beer mug of German origin.
